arguments.value: Cynthia M. Rufe, born in Philadelphia in 1948, has served as a United States District Judge for the Eastern District of Pennsylvania since her nomination by President George W. Bush in 2002, assuming senior status in 2021. She earned her B.A. from Adelphi University in 1970 and her J.D. from the State University of New York at Buffalo Law School in 1977. Before joining the federal bench, Judge Rufe worked with the Bucks County Public Defender’s Office, including as assistant and coordinator of the Juvenile Division and as deputy public defender, served as solicitor for the Bucks County Children and Youth Social Services Agency, maintained a private practice in Pennsylvania, and was a judge on the Bucks County Court of Common Pleas from 1994 to 2002.
